say:1:1411407101:0.text: Whoa! Was that magic?! It doesn't hurt at all now!
say:1:1411407101:0.source_cn: 这是魔法吗？！太神奇了，我的伤口一点都不疼了！
say:1:1411407101:0.male: Whoa! Was that magic?! It doesn't hurt at all now!
say:1:1411407101:0.female: Whoa! Was that magic?! It doesn't hurt at all now!

say:2:1411407102:0.text: Thank you so much! I still need to rest for a bit, though. My legs feel weak.
say:2:1411407102:0.source_cn: 谢谢你，不过我还得再坐一会儿，腿还是有些软。
say:2:1411407102:0.male: Thank you so much! I still need to rest for a bit, though. My legs feel weak.
say:2:1411407102:0.female: Thank you so much! I still need to rest for a bit, though. My legs feel weak.

say:4:1411407103:0.text: Don't stay too long. There may be aftershocks. Is there anyone else nearby?
say:4:1411407103:0.source_cn: 别待太久，很可能还会发生余震。对了，这附近还有别人吗？

say:5:1411407104:1.text: Yeah, there are some other dwarves down here. I saw someone lose their balance and fall down.
say:5:1411407104:1.source_cn: 有吧，挺多的人的，我刚还看到有人一下没站稳，摔在地上滚...

say:6:1411407105:1.text: I think some rocks landed on someone. I heard some screaming over there.
say:6:1411407105:1.source_cn: 还有人躲到角落去，被石头砸了下脑袋，嗷嗷叫个不停。

say:7:1411407106:1.text: But the majority of us were able to escape.
say:7:1411407106:1.source_cn: 不过都没什么大事，跑出来的和像我这样摔倒的还是占多数。

say:8:1411407107:1.text: Don't worry. The overseer will arrange a rescue team later. We're dwarves. We know what to do in our mines.
say:8:1411407107:1.source_cn: 队长等会儿也会安排人救助的，你们不用担心，矿洞可是我们...

say:9:1411407108:1.text: Alright. Have your overseer report any issues to me. I can allocate more manpower.
say:9:1411407108:1.source_cn: 好，记得和你们队长说，要做好登记，有什么问题随时找我汇报！
